description: The national EC interrogation twins FUNCTION EXCEPTION-FILE-N (ISO 15.29) / EXCEPTION-LOCATION-N (15.31) - the ONLY -N EC twins the 2023 text defines (none exists for EXCEPTION-STATEMENT/-STATUS). LIVE (P10 Step-11 EC-N wave): the base EcFunctions renderings projected national through the ONE NationalOf repertoire translator (15.29.4 r1c / 15.31.3 r2b 'converted at runtime to the runtime national character set'), result category National (Table-16 legality). 2002 introductions (the EC model + national data are both 2002; the 2023 delta is only EXCEPTION-FILE-N's optional file-connector argument, E.3.3 item 26 - staged loud, PHASE-13 Step 9). Below 2002 the D8 catalog window rejects by name+edition (COBOL1502).
